1. **[blocking][issue-impact] F1:** `publish_staged_artifact` accepts an unverified `StagedArtifact`; verification returns `()` and does not produce a verified-only capability. A caller can stage and publish arbitrary bytes without supplying or checking the recorded SHA-256/size, violating the required verified-staging publication contract. [artifact_mutation.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/artifact_mutation.rs:191) (`@/invariant/atomic-writes`).

2. **[blocking][issue-impact] F2:** An occupied symlink destination does not return `AlreadyExists`. `publish_staged_artifact` calls `physical_repo_path` first, which rejects a symlink leaf as `SymlinkArtifact` before the collision checks. This violates the hard requirement that every occupied destination returns `AlreadyExists`; existing tests cover only regular-file collisions. [artifact_mutation.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/artifact_mutation.rs:193) (`@/invariant/atomic-writes`).
